name: human-in-the-loop
description: Claude assigns you the tasks only you can do. They wait in a My tasks pane, counted under the prompt, until you answer or reject them, so nothing Claude needs from you gets lost in the chat.

answer_endpoint.title: Answer endpoint
answer_endpoint.description: Off unless turned on. On, each session listens on a Unix socket in the profile for answers to its tasks from another program on this machine (the dashboard, say), behind a token only this user can read. See the README, Answer endpoint.
